summary: OSpec 1.8.21 adds an explicit double-confirmed force-archive path that preserves incomplete evidence and marks every generated archive surface as accepted risk.
new: Added ospec finalize --force-archive with exact change-name confirmation and a mandatory inline or file-based audit reason.
improved: Forced archives retain failed checks, pending steps, blockers, and NOT_VERIFIED evidence instead of presenting them as completed work.
Generated archive knowledge, feature indexes, and SKILL.index.json visibly identify forced incomplete accepted-risk records.
fixed: Added a supported closeout path for users who intentionally accept residual risk without hand-editing task graphs, reviews, or evidence.
Prevented force archive while a Loop action is pending and preserved transactional rollback across state, proposal, audit record, knowledge, links, and indexes.
docs: Documented the double-confirmation command, non-bypassable safety checks, audit record, and AI authorization boundary.
